description: This file contains SQL statements defining schema (tables, procedures, and queries) for managing grain directory information and grain activation registration within Orleans cluster. It includes table creation, stored procedures for registering, unregistering, and looking up grain activations, and some query insertions for procedure invocations.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to register or update a grain activation in the OrleansGrainDirectory.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to unregister a specific grain activation from the OrleansGrainDirectory.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to look up a grain's activation details in the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivations
methods.description: Procedure to unregister all grain activations for a given silo addresses in the directory.
